title: Audax Italiano vs Ñublense: match that shakes the Chilean table
seoTitle: Audax Italiano vs Ñublense shakes Chilean table
subtitle: Bicentenario Stadium in La Florida hosts a duel that may change clubs' positions in the competition
excerpt: Italian Audax faces Ñublense this Monday, 08/10, at the Bicentenario Stadium in La Florida. The match, part of the Chilean Primera División, has generated...
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Monday, August 10, Audax Italiano and Ñublense meet at the Bicentenario Stadium in La Florida, at 9 p.m. (Brasília time). The clash, part of the Chilean Primera División, stands out for the sequence of goals and the offensive pressure both teams have been showing.

Audax Italiano at home: recent performance

The home side has scored in 100% of its last five matches of the season, maintaining an average of 1.40 goals per game. Despite registering only 42.0% ball possession, the team shows efficiency in converting chances into goals. At its own stadium, Audax Italiano has kept a 60% unbeaten rate in the last five home games.

Ñublense: aggressive attack away from home

Ñublense arrives with an intense offensive profile, recording an average of 18.0 shots per game, with 7.0 on target. The team scores in 80% of its recent matches and, as a visitor, has conceded only 0.40 goals on average, having suffered just one defeat in recent away games.

Numbers showdown: what the match indicates

The indicators point to a lively duel. While Audax Italiano has shown regularity by scoring in all recent matches, Ñublense brings a volume of shots that can test the Chilean defense. The expectation is that the goalkeepers of both teams will be heavily demanded, given the combination of the home team's efficiency and the visitor's offensive aggression.

Where to watch the game in Brazil

Live and exclusive broadcast for the Brazilian audience will be provided by the streaming service Zapping, on the Zapping Sports channel. Access to the game allows fans to follow the match in real time, with the option to comment on the plays and analyze the presented statistics.

Expectations for the duel

Considering the slight overall ranking advantage of Ñublense, but also the strength of Audax Italiano in its own stadium, the clash is likely to be balanced. The combination of an efficient home attack and the visitor's shot pressure suggests a scenario of goal opportunities for both sides, reinforcing the importance of the result for the table battle.
